brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Two keyhole hanger accessories on rear face (accessory:0#-1,0#1 and accessory:0#1,0#1, slots 1, facing wall) on 3-cell bar -1,0 to 1,0 level 0. Allows lift-and-drop mounting on wall screws.

Three hook plate accessories (hex-acc-hook, each with two hooks) on front face slot 4 across all three cells (accessory:0#-1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4) providing 6 hook positions for pliers, wrenches, etc. Props not shown in viewer due to low single-storey height vs bench in simulator, but hardware is placed and check_build clear.

finish.summary: Linear 3-cell tool rack with two rear keyhole hangers for wall mounting and three front hook plates (6 hooks) for hand tools. Joints locked and end caps fitted.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
